entries.28a50cfc72a32ce5: A single-segment business that provides solutions based on the software platform “Blue Earth Platform (BEP)”, which remotely controls and centrally manages multiple autonomous mobile robots (such as drones and AGVs). The solutions replace with drones and AGVs tasks previously performed by people, such as facility inspection and logistics, to improve efficiency, safety and labor savings. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,051 million, and the business consists of four solutions: Inspection, Port, Education and Next.
entries.2b6a5d5f9a2193d4: The business description states that the company's strengths are the selection of sensors suited to special environments and its technology for estimating its own position by combining multiple sensors (multi-sensor positioning). It also states that it does not develop hardware, unlike hardware makers that face intense global competition, but instead develops and provides software that connects with any hardware device, and that its drone education business contributes to its distinctive position in the industry.
